tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Finds crypto projects whose name or symbol contains the query, largest TVL first, with slug, category, TVL and market cap. Includes blockchains' own projects (flagged `is_chain`: true; use chain_metrics for the chain, project_metrics for its coin). Use the slug with the other project tools. Free dat

tools.name: project_metrics
tools.description: A crypto project's current metrics from AlphaGrowth: TVL, price, market cap, volume, revenue, users and social followers with 1d/7d/30d changes, plus its description, categories, chains and links. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: project_tvl_history
tools.description: A crypto project's total value locked per day (USD, with its staking part) for up to 3650 days, and its TVL on each chain it runs on: the latest value and share, plus one point per day (at most 365 days back) with chain_history=yes. Chain projects carry their chain's TVL and no chain split. Free dat

tools.name: project_community
tools.description: How fast a crypto project's community is growing: followers or members per network (X/Twitter, Telegram, Discord, Reddit) with 1d/7d/30d percent changes and one point per day for up to 90 days. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: rank_projects
tools.description: Ranks crypto projects by a metric such as TVL, market cap, price, revenue or followers (or its 1d/7d/30d change), optionally within a category or chain, 50 per page. Sub-projects such as Aave V2 and Aave V3 rank as their own rows beside their parent. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: categories
tools.description: Crypto project categories (DEXs, lending, RWA, gaming, ...) with their slugs, most projects first, 50 per page; top-level categories also carry their projects' combined TVL, market cap and 30d changes. Use a slug as the category filter of rank_projects, recent_funding_rounds and upcoming_projects. F

tools.name: upcoming_tges

tools.name: project_funding
tools.description: A crypto project's funding rounds (oldest first, with date, amount, type and valuation where known), the investors behind them and the total raised. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: recent_funding_rounds

tools.name: top_investors
tools.description: The top 100 crypto investors ranked by number of projects funded or by total amount invested, with their first 20 funded projects (projects_more counts the rest), 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: investor_profile
tools.description: A crypto investor's public profile (type, location, website, industries, investment criteria) and its investments, newest first, 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: chains
tools.description: Blockchains ranked by TVL with price, market cap, 1d/7d TVL change and how many projects run on each, 50 per page. Use a chain's slug with chain_metrics and its chain_slug as the chain filter of rank_projects. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: spaces
tools.description: Recorded and transcribed crypto X (Twitter) Spaces and broadcasts, newest first, 50 per page: title, date, duration, an AI summary and who spoke. Search titles and summaries with query; read a recording's transcript and Q&A with space. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.description: One transcribed crypto X (Twitter) Space by slug (as listed by spaces): its AI summary, hosts and speakers with the projects they spoke for, the questions and answers drawn from it, and its timestamped transcript, 200 snippets per transcript_page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: dao_treasuries
tools.description: Lists DAO treasuries worth more than $500, largest first: total USD value, 24h change, category, top tokens and main chain. Use the links for a DAO's daily history. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: dao_treasury_snapshot
tools.description: Every listed DAO's treasury value in USD as of one UTC day (the last sample up to 6 days before it), largest first, for any day since 2024-07-24 up to yesterday (default: yesterday). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: dao_treasury_history
tools.description: Daily total treasury value in USD of one DAO, one point per UTC day (the day's last sample), daily since 2024-07-24; defaults to the whole history. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: dao_holdings_history
tools.description: Daily token holdings of one DAO treasury (amount, USD value and price per token, one point per token per UTC day), daily since 2024-07-24. At most 92 days per call, the last 30 days by default. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: dao_treasury
tools.description: One DAO treasury by id: total USD value, 24h change, category, top tokens and main chain. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spaces · Private data: upcoming_projects, upcoming_tges, treasury_companies, yield_pools, yield_pool, token_unlocks, dao_treasuries, dao_holdings_history, dao_treasury · Public sink: project_tvl_history, token_unlocks · Destructive: chains.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spaces · Private data: upcoming_projects, upcoming_tges, treasury_companies, yield_pools, yield_pool, token_unlocks, dao_treasuries, dao_holdings_history, dao_treasury · Public sink: project_tvl_history, token_unlocks · Destructive: chains

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
